column1: # Functions that contain something no function body can match.
# Sorted by score within each cause: a high score is a function
# already at its ceiling, a low one is a body still to write that
# will meet the same ceiling afterwards.
# Each cause, and what it would take to lift it:
#   assert-file-line     an assert carries __FILE__ and __LINE__, which are the build machine's
#   compiler-generated   the original is a member MSVC wrote; ours is a hand-written stub, and only `= default` can produce the same code
#   delegating-ctor      the original delegates to another constructor, which needs a mem-initializer - part of the head, not the body

#   jump-table           a switch's jump table sits in .text inside the function's extent and delink's x86 path does not recover it (its x86-64 path does), so the table is scored as instructions our object does not have

#   rtc-extent           delink did not find this function's _RTC_CheckStackVars descriptor, so the symbol still runs over it and its trailing bytes are scored as instructions our object does not have. Where the descriptor *is* found it is named `<function>$rtcframedesc` and this is no longer a ceiling
